verdict.rationale: Notion markets and documents a built-in AI assistant/agent layer ('Get answers, instantly—with citations', 'Keep work moving 24/7 with agents') plus first-party Agent APIs for sessions, chat, streaming replies, and Custom Agents management, showing the assistant is a native, delegable feature rather than a third-party bolt-on. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating real-world task delegation quality and reliability, and more detail on in-app assistant UX beyond marketing copy and API docs.
